convert.title: Enroll {name}
convert.hint: Creates the student, links the guardian, enrolls them in the group with the first charge, and marks the lead won.
convert.done: {name} is now a student and enrolled in the group.
convert.guardianHint: Optional. A phone that's already a guardian links that guardian (siblings share one).

lostReasons.title: Lost reasons
lostReasons.listHint: Offered when a lead is marked lost. Archived reasons stay on old leads.
lostReasons.archiveHint: It won't be offered any more; leads that already have it keep it.

list.title: Recent score entries
list.hint: Every mock and diagnostic entered for a group. Open one to see the group's scores.
list.emptyHint: Open a group and press “Enter scores”.

enter.title: Enter scores · {group}
enter.hint: Tab moves across, Enter moves down. Leave a row empty to skip a student; clearing a saved row removes that result.
enter.saved: {saved, plural, one {# result saved} other {# results saved}}{deleted, plural, =0 {} one {, # removed} other {, # removed}}. Parents get a message in 10 minutes.
enter.noStudents: This group has no students yet.
enter.existing: Scores for this day are already saved: you're editing them.

group.emptyHint: Enter the group's first diagnostic or mock.

student.emptyHint: Results appear here when a teacher enters a group's mock, or when you add an official result.
student.deleteHint: It disappears from the chart and the group's table.

target.title: Target · {exam}
target.baselineHint: Leave empty to use the first diagnostic.
target.clearHint: Leave the score and the date empty to remove the target.

official.title: Official result
official.uploadFailed: The certificate couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
official.tooBig: The file is larger than 10 MB.

types.title: Exam types
types.listHint: Standard exams are the same for every center. Add your own for internal tests.
types.name: Name
types.inUse: Scores already use this type, so its sections and total stay as they are.
types.archiveHint: It's no longer offered for new scores; saved scores stay.
